description: Different model profiles should preserve Gradle Groovy/JUnit JVM planning decisions for covered validators, untested formatters, and DTO deferral.

lockedFields.reason: The Gradle Groovy fixture has JUnit tests, src/test/java conventions, and a runnable gradle test command.
Gradle Groovy JVM fixtures should keep using gradle test as the verification command.
The covered validator should remain an extend-test candidate.
The untested formatter should remain an add-test candidate.
The covered validator should remain the first high-priority candidate.
Existing JUnit coverage should stay visible to downstream model prompts.
The untested formatter should remain a direct unit-test candidate.
The DTO record should remain deferred instead of receiving a direct low-value test.
